newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - May 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - May 16.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Friday's Daily Variety:
* A Delaware judge ruled that Viacom Inc breached its USA Networks partnership agreement with MCA Inc, a unit of Seagram Co Ltd.
* Sean Connery, Edward Norton and Gwyneth Paltrow are expected to join Warner Bros.' "The Runaway Jury," sources said.
* Time Warner Inc Chairman Gerald Levin promised shareholders at the company's annual meeting that he has a "firm and disciplined financial plan" for the entertainment giant.

* TriStar Pictures' "Godzilla" will open next summer with an estimated $20 million in media support from Taco Bell, the PepsiCo-owned restaurant chain currently tied into the Warner Bros franchise "Batman and Robin."
* French pay TV giant Canal Plus has signed an exclusive deal for pay-per-view and pay TV rights with Miramax Film Corp.
* The Arts Council of England has awarded three film production franchises to be funded by national lottery.
